# Run archive

The run archive is the directory one explain run persists: `manifest.json`, `base_generation.txt` and an SQLite database `archive.sqlite` (WAL journaling, schema version 4) with one row per coalition evaluation: key, packed mask, policy, model, timing, the generated text and its token logprobs (`NULL` when the backend returned none). A completion marker distinguishes finished runs. It lets Reanalyze (`knowledge/concepts/Reanalyze.md`) re-score the run without the model.

Identified by the Run id (`knowledge/concepts/Run id.md`); described by the Manifest (`knowledge/concepts/Manifest.md`). Fixed issue: C02 (`knowledge/issues/Fixed issues.md`).

Source: `knowledge/concepts/Run archive.md`.
